important_instructions: Age Limits and Experience will be reckoned as on 1st October, 2026. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the 'Careers' section on the official website at www.gujaratmetrorail.com. Register on the portal using basic details such as Name, DOB, category, Mobile number, and email ID. Log in using the passcode sent to your registered email ID. Select the position for which you are applying. Fill in the on-line application with relevant details latest to earliest and complete the application form. Check the entered details using the preview option available and submit the form after verifying all information.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Detailed curriculum vitae Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate Educational Qualification: SSC marksheet, HSC marksheets, Graduation all year/semester marksheets & degree/diploma certificates Experience certificates with joining date, relieving date, department worked, and pay details / CTC breakup (Form 16) Details of current organization: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip, and Form-16 of last three years NOC and last 5 years APAR (for candidates working in PSU/Boards/Organization of Government/Metro Rail Corporations)

content_sections.heading: GMRC Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Age Limits and Experience will be reckoned as on 1st October, 2026. Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat State for at least 03 years and are conversant with the Gujarati Language. Document verification shall be done before the Interview; candidates must carry original certificates. Selected candidates must indicate acceptance of the offer within three working days from receipt. Canvassing by or on behalf of candidates will lead to disqualification. Medical fitness standard for Sr. Section Engineer & Section Engineer is A-3 category.

faq.question: Q1. What is GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GMRC Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Limited for 15 Operations & Maintenance posts on contract, deputation, or post-superannuation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies announced under notification number GMRCL/HR/RECT/O&M/Oct-2026/27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 21st October, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GMRC posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E. / B.Tech or equivalent engineering degree in relevant disciplines (Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, Instrumentation, etc.) from a recognized University/Institute, along with required post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GMRC Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the post of Manager is 40 years.
